description:
Review uncommitted vault changes, then stage and commit them.

Subcommands:
  review [--max-file-lines N] [--max-lines N] — show everything that changed since the last commit; read-only
  save --message SUBJECT [--body BODY] [--dry-run] — stage every change in the vault and commit it

Flags:
  review: --max-file-lines max diff lines shown per file, default 150; --max-lines max lines of output overall, default 3000
  save: --message commit subject, required, must be a single non-empty line; --body commit body, may span multiple lines; --dry-run report what would be staged and committed without changing anything

Examples:
  ["review"]
  ["save", "--message", "Log August hours and flush buffer", "--dry-run"]
  ["save", "--message", "Log August hours and flush buffer", "--body", "Added 6 entries against Projects/SGB.\nFlushed 3 buffer captures into logs/."]

Notes:
  Run `review` first and write the message from what it shows; diffs are truncated by the --max-* limits.
  `save` stages every change in the vault. It can only add a commit — it never amends, rebases, resets, checks out, or pushes.
  Exits 1 if --message is empty or spans multiple lines, if the vault root is not a git repository root or not a directory, or if git itself fails.
